description: Retrieval evaluation set for the NoteMind demo notes. Questions are paraphrased (not copied from the PDFs) so keyword search gets no unfair advantage. 'expected' lists every page that answers the question; a retrieval counts as a hit if any of them is retrieved. Unanswerable questions have answerable=false and are used to measure refusals; several are deliberate near-misses (same subject area, but the notes do not cover them).
